item.title: yetone's Alma Agent Harness Placed Third Midway Through FrontierHarness v1.1 and Finished Sixth

item.title: D-Robotics and Infinigence AI Bring RLinf and Three Other Open-Source Robot Tools to Sunrise Chips
item.description: D-Robotics and Infinigence AI link RLark, RLinf, RPent and APXInf to Sunrise chips and RoboGo. RLinf is on RoboGo, and APXInf runs Pi0.5 on Sunrise S600.

item.title: COMAC's CE-25A Electric Commercial Aircraft Completes Its First Crewed Flight
item.description: COMAC's 19-seat CE-25A electric aircraft flew with two pilots and a flight test engineer aboard for the first time, covering 60.4 km in 16 minutes 38 seconds.
